tmdb-movie-1239037.title: 深度安静
tmdb-movie-1239037.overview: 影片改编自林秀赫同名短篇小说。讲述谕明与依庭相遇于大学图书馆里的深度安静区，两人相爱并走入婚姻，正期待迎接第一个孩子。然而，依庭的意外自杀让谕明陷入混乱与痛苦。他想起依庭在怀孕后变得异常，甚至提出离婚。自责的谕明照顾起依庭的家人，透过深入了解她的家庭后，开始理解她的行径，以及她无法面对自己父亲的原因，真相却让人难以接受。

tmdb-movie-925725.title: 霹雳英雄：素还真
tmdb-movie-925725.overview: 少年素还真身怀绝艺，初入江湖原想见识广大世界，却因为新结识的好友卷入了险恶的夺权纷争，就连他的老师都因他遭难。

tmdb-movie-1567259.title: 试探
tmdb-movie-1567259.overview: 为了测试男友丁伯阳对自己的爱，万影策划了一场失踪事件，让丁伯阳陷入短暂的痛苦中。此时，年轻惹火的马娅趁机上位，与丁伯阳光速热恋，激情同居。可马娅不知道的是，打从自己搬进丁伯阳家的一刻起，自己也成为了这场试探游戏的危险玩家之一…

tmdb-movie-1817684.title: 孤楼夜幽灵
tmdb-movie-1817684.overview: 女子林欣因一次意外而丧失记忆，雨夜，别墅里发生诡异事件，女儿失踪。二十年过去，林欣恢复记忆，再次回到女儿失踪的地方，找到女儿，揭开了二十年前发生在母女亲情背后的真相。

tmdb-movie-1502116.title: 二十四味
tmdb-movie-1502116.overview: 出国多年后回到故土的四月（袁澧林 饰），发现早已离异的父母重拾旧好，年少时她以极端自虐的方式挽留出轨父亲（钟镇涛 饰）的记忆再度浮现。凉茶铺正面临拆迁，四月要带巧珍（张艾嘉 饰）出国生活，巧珍却希望继续经营凉茶铺。重回家庭的落魄永堂默默为巧珍筹措重开凉茶铺的资金，拼尽全力却误中骗局。一团乱麻时，四月又遇野蛮生长、同父异母的妹妹小景。她将过去逃避的生活、时间以及自省一点点拾起。

tmdb-movie-1823092.title: 顾炎武
tmdb-movie-1823092.overview: 主要讲述了顾炎武还乡途中，回忆平生：“誓不仕清”；身陷文字狱却因书未成不敢轻生；将弟子送进清朝“博学鸿儒科”考场；生命终时向少年康熙解读“何谓亡国，何谓亡天下”的故事。

related.title: 欢迎回家，罗斯科·杰金斯

tmdb-movie-1822400.title: 金哲
tmdb-movie-1822400.overview: 1983年夏，七岁的尚民到吉童村姥姥家过暑假，遇见了被全村叫作"傻子"的金哲。山野间的疯跑嬉戏，抓河蚌、捉迷藏，让尚民读懂了他藏在"傻"背后的孤独，而这份不掺杂质的陪伴，也让长久被轻视的金哲，第一次萌生出了为自己赢一次的勇气。夏末，村里摔跤赛开场，金哲第一次代表村子站上赛场赢得尊严。

tmdb-tv-295778.title: 实习医生风云
tmdb-tv-295778.overview: 约多(J.D.)与特克睽违多年，再度合体执刀。医学环境物换星移，实习医生也早已换了一批，但他们坚不可摧的兄弟情谊始终如一。新旧角色齐聚圣心医院，在充满欢笑、感动与惊喜的行医路上，继续向前迈进。

tmdb-tv-62650.title: 芝加哥急救
tmdb-tv-62650.overview: 《芝加哥急救》是《芝加哥烈焰》（Chicago Fire）的第二部衍生剧，故事描述芝加哥城中最繁忙的一家医院的日常工作——这里有一支勇敢无惧的医护团队，他们团结一致，敢于面对任何风险。每当特定事件（灾难）中的病人需要救治，或者遇到别的医生束手无策的疑难杂症，就轮到他们上场了。与此同时，他们在混乱的急诊室里培养出紧密的关系并一起渡过难关。根据NBC的构想，该剧和《芝加哥烈焰》、《芝加哥警署》经常交换角色和情节，使三个团队（三部剧集）有机地融和在一起。

tmdb-tv-125935.title: 小学风云
tmdb-tv-125935.overview: 一群敬业、热情的老师和一位略显失聪的校长聚集在费城的一所公立学校，决心帮助学生在生活中取得成功。

tmdb-tv-44006.title: 芝加哥烈焰
tmdb-tv-44006.overview: 该剧以主要讲述了芝加哥51号消防站应急救援队的故事。这一群英勇的消费队员们包括：副队长Kelly、队长Walter、急救员Gabriella，对自己的工作十分忠诚、资深消防员Christopher、玩命消防员Matthew、准消防员Peter等。这群勇敢无惧的男女却义无反顾地冲进最危险的地方，每天都要和死神打交道，要在最紧张的时候做出最重要选择，每天都要面对自尊与自负的考验，工作的责任和压力给他们的性格带来了巨大影响。

tmdb-tv-2190.title: 南方公园
tmdb-tv-2190.overview: 讲述科罗拉多州南方公园小镇上，斯坦、凯尔、卡特曼和肯尼四个孩子的生活。他们不断卷入超自然事件、社会冲突和各种荒诞危机，并以孩子的视角面对成年人世界中的政治、宗教、文化和社会问题。

tmdb-tv-58841.title: 芝加哥警署
tmdb-tv-58841.overview: 芝加哥警署的第21辖区有两组完全不同的警察。其中一组是穿制服的警察，负责在街道上巡逻，直接打击和处理街头犯罪行为。另一组被称作情报组，负责打击危害这座城市的主要毒瘤——黑帮犯罪、毒品走私、高级别谋杀案，诸如此类。负责领导情报组的的是Hank Voight警官（Jason Beghe）。他是一个不怕破坏规矩的人——只要能维护正义，哪怕和法律对着干他也在所不惜。他为人强悍，要求严格，只有那些能上得刀山下得火海的人才能在他的手下当差。就拿Antonio Dawson侦探（Jon Seda）来说——尽管他与上司有过一段复杂的历史，但他对于指挥这样一个团队充满雄心。即便那意味着他每天都要和Voight闹矛盾，也阻止不了他要留下来的决心。那些街头巡警每天都在盯着情报组看，他们梦想得到升职并加入这个精英团队。而对于已经身在其中的人来说，这份工作每天都意味着挑战，他们必须为这座城市保驾护航并承担巨大的责任。有些时候责任会变成压力，而压力会带来心理和情感上的创伤——走出第21辖区的办公室，走入这些侦探的个人生活，你就会明白这句话的含义。

tmdb-tv-273247.title: 独家黑幕
tmdb-tv-273247.overview: 塔尔萨的公民记者李·雷本自称“真相守护者”，执着于揭露腐败与社会阴暗面。他不断追查各种事件背后的真相，即使因此身陷危险，也不愿停止调查。

tmdb-tv-203489.title: 瘪四与大头蛋
tmdb-tv-203489.overview: 金发瘪四与黑发大头蛋是一对正值青春期的死党，他们认为凡是只能归纳为两类，不是酷就是逊！这对荷尔蒙分泌过盛的宝贝并不笨，只是聪明没用对地方，他们满脑子想的都是怎样上马子，急欲摆脱处男之身的他们可以把任何事物都形容得“性“致勃勃，令人绝倒！本片缘起于瘪赐与大头蛋的电视遭窃，他们急著上天下海四处找寻，终于来到一煎破旅馆，遇到个叫曼迪的老粗。曼迪说他愿付一万元雇他们去洛杉矶“做“了他老婆，色欲薰心的瘪四与大头蛋一听，不禁喜出望外，殊不知此“做“非彼“做“！于是，他们欢天喜地的搭上往洛杉矶的飞机，展开他们的处男航（第一次搭飞机）。但到了洛杉矶，事情并不如他们所想像的，为了追上曼迪的前妻，瘪四与大头蛋始终周旋在两名联邦调查员和一群老人之间。

tmdb-tv-258742.title: 诉讼女王
tmdb-tv-258742.overview: 一群女律师脱离男性主导的事务所，自立门户，开创自己的事业。她们精明干练，心思细腻，处理各种棘手的离婚案件、丑闻秘辛，以及法庭内外不断变化的结盟关系。在金钱至上、爱情如战场的世界里，她们不只是参与者，更是游戏规则的改变者。

tmdb-tv-1871.title: 东区人
tmdb-tv-1871.overview: 阿尔伯特广场（Albert Square）的工人阶级居民的日常生活，阿尔伯特广场是维多利亚时代的传统露台露台，周围环绕着伦敦沃尔福德区东端的一个公园。

tmdb-tv-131488.title: 茜茜皇后
tmdb-tv-131488.overview: 叛逆的伊丽莎白对皇帝弗朗兹一见倾心，并出人意料地成为了皇帝的新娘。从此，她不得不应对维也纳宫廷的种种纷争与阴谋。

tmdb-tv-6647.title: 大胆而美丽
tmdb-tv-6647.overview: 持续的戏剧融合了浪漫与阴谋，背景是比佛利山庄和美国时尚产业的璀璨背景。

tmdb-tv-987.title: 综合医院
tmdb-tv-987.overview: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

tmdb-tv-94686.title: 姐妹们
tmdb-tv-94686.overview: A group of single black women from different walks of life navigate their complicated love life status, careers and friendship through the ups-and-downs of living in a modern world of social media and unrealistic relationship goals.

tmdb-tv-881.title: 我们的日子
tmdb-tv-881.overview: 本剧主要描述两个家庭：荷顿(Hortons)家族和布雷迪(Bradys)家族。 很多其他家族也进入到这个团队，并且偶尔露面。荷顿家族的女家长，Frances Reid从该剧成立以来一直参与演出直到2010年2月3日逝世。 Suzanne Rogers在我们的日子38周年庆生会中，回顾她第一次于1973年出场。 Susan Seaforth Hayes 则是唯一的从开播到现在都还在的角色。

tmdb-tv-75219.title: 紧急呼救
tmdb-tv-75219.overview: 这部剧讲述了包括警察、消防员和调遣员在内的急救人员的高压经历，他们遇到的最可怕、令人震惊和惊心动魄的情境。这些急救人员必须努力在拯救最脆弱的人与解决他们自己生活中的问题之间取得平衡。该节目取材于生活中急救人员经常面临的难以预料的、令人紧张却又振奋人心的现实事件。

related.title: 乡巴佬希尔一家的幸福生活
乔治·伯恩斯和格雷西·艾伦秀

tmdb-tv-243875.title: 乔治和曼迪的头婚生活
tmdb-tv-243875.overview: 《小谢尔顿》的衍生剧集。乔治和曼迪在德克萨斯州抚养他们的年轻家庭，同时应对成年、育儿和婚姻的挑战。

tmdb-tv-2734.title: 法律与秩序：特殊受害者
tmdb-tv-2734.overview: 被残忍杀害的年轻女子、被虐的婴儿、被近亲性侵害的女童、家暴阴影下手足无措的妇女、失调扭曲的家庭关系、很想用心但每每力有未迨的父母、杵在社会家庭人际边缘人性的灰色地带。SVU每回总是触动那块让人无从防备的柔软地带，可爱的孩童，无辜的弱势个体（受性侵害者、同性恋、精神病患），每个人都多少有些经验感触的亲子、家庭关系。不见得得是多复杂的剧情，像今天，忙于工作单亲母亲剧烈摇晃死自己的一岁多幼女(Shake Syndrome)，幼小无辜的女孩在母亲一时的暴怒下被辗压击碎，但另一方面你多了解那种拉扯在工作亲子关系中的心力交瘁，可爱时像天使哭闹起来却像恶魔一样让你抓狂的孩子，要怎么以审判指控那、为了不舍得看到无恢复希望的孩子继续受到病痛折磨而毅然决定停止呼吸器，哪怕这将使自己已因杀罪被起诉的母亲？是以就算这是再滥情的一种搬演、操控，每每总还是让观众溃不成军...

tmdb-tv-226285.title: 奇思妙探
tmdb-tv-226285.overview: Elsbeth Tascioni是一位精明但异于常人的律师，在芝加哥取得事业上的成功后，她来到了纽约。Elsbeth运用自己的奇异视角进行着独特的观察，协同纽约警局要员追捕那些犯罪手法高超的罪犯。

tmdb-tv-549.title: 法律与秩序
tmdb-tv-549.overview: 本片融警匪与法庭于一体的电视剧，片中讲述的犯罪基本原于真实生活，往往是近期报纸上的头条新闻。节目分为两部分，上半部分介绍警察研究现场，征询证人，提审嫌疑犯等一系列的侦破活动，后半部分详尽记录了案件侦破的后期工作，案件转交到检查官手里，检查官衡量案情，起诉，直到庭审，节奏紧凑，扣人心弦。由于最终坏人不一定被绳之于法，所以观众看的时候往往暗自捏一把汗。

profile.tagline: 你拯救的生命也许将是你自己

tmdb-tv-1416.title: 实习医生格蕾
tmdb-tv-1416.overview: 西雅图格雷斯医院迎来新一批实习生，梅雷迪斯·格雷、克里斯蒂娜·杨、伊泽贝尔·斯蒂文、乔治·梅利 、亚里克斯·卡莱，五个医学院好友同期毕业，需要以良好表现争夺住院医师正式席位。进入医院伊始，梅雷迪斯崩溃地发现前晚在酒吧和她发生一夜情的男人，竟然是神经外科医生德立克·舍伯，两人纠葛就此开始；克里斯蒂娜吸引了胸外科医师普雷斯顿·伯克的注意，因为他们同样高傲和野心勃勃；乔治悄悄爱着梅雷迪斯；美丽的伊泽贝尔第一时间掀起流言，一年的实习期注定充满高密度的压力竞争与荷尔蒙……

tmdb-tv-153312.title: 塔尔萨之王
tmdb-tv-153312.overview: 纽约黑手党头目德怀特·曼弗雷迪服刑25年后获释，却被组织放逐至俄克拉何马州塔尔萨。他逐步招募一群意想不到的伙伴，在这座陌生城市建立自己的犯罪帝国。

related.title: 好女孩的谋杀调查报告

tmdb-tv-292741.title: 夜曲
tmdb-tv-292741.overview: 改编自拉尔斯·克卜勒的小说《拉撒路》和《睡魔》。恶名昭彰的连环杀手尤里克·沃尔特的一名受害者意外生还，警探乔纳·林分秒必争务求找出唯一仍然失踪的人，同时他的徒弟萨加·鲍尔则充当卧底，试图从杀手身上获得答案。

tmdb-tv-261317.title: 槲寄生谋杀案
tmdb-tv-261317.overview: 《槲寄生谋杀案》是由Hallmark+制作的惊悚犯罪剧集，讲述当圣诞礼品店老板艾米丽·莱恩调查当地一起树木农场的谋杀案时，她的侦探技能受到了考验。尽管山姆·威尔纳警探对艾米丽的感情越来越深，但一块有毒的饼干却将她与犯罪联系起来，而艾米莉神秘的过去也让人怀疑她调查谋杀案的真正动机。

tmdb-tv-313630.title: 永属于你
tmdb-tv-313630.overview: 一部讲述永恒爱情的故事，讲述了一对结婚已有五百年之久的吸血鬼夫妇，以及他们努力接受与自己女儿交往的人类男子的经历。

tmdb-tv-298852.title: 律界战争
tmdb-tv-298852.overview: 两家伦敦顶级律所围绕一场轰动全城的离婚案展开较量。随着案件升级，野心、背叛与利益交织，每个人都不惜一切争取胜利。

tmdb-tv-284838.title: 紧急呼救：纳什维尔
tmdb-tv-284838.overview: 故事设定在美国最多元、最有活力的城市之一纳什维尔，聚焦于英勇的第一线应急救护人员，也深入他们充满权力与魅力的家族故事。

tmdb-tv-303630.title: 库比蒂诺
tmdb-tv-303630.overview: 一名律师遭前雇主科技初创公司侵吞股票期权。他拒绝妥协，与另一名刚被解雇的律师联手创办律所，帮助遭科技巨头侵害的人们维权，向掌控硅谷的强大企业发起挑战。

tmdb-tv-249565.title: The Good Daughter
tmdb-tv-249565.overview: The Good Daughter is a suspenseful crime drama where sisters Charlotte and Samantha Quinn have spent the last twenty-eight years trying to piece together the lives that were fractured by a single night of violence. When another attack splinters the small town of Pikeville, Charlotte is the first witness on the scene. Now a lawyer like her father, she's forced to confront her own demons as the case twists through one shocking revelation after another. In the end, both she and Samantha find themselves wondering if the price of being the good daughter was worth it after all.

tmdb-tv-253391.title: 治安官之乡
tmdb-tv-253391.overview: 《烈焰国度》衍生剧。直率的治安官米奇・福克斯驻守埃奇沃特小镇，巡逻侦办罪案，同时兼顾家庭难题。她既要面对有前科、私种大麻的父亲韦斯，也要守护宣誓捍卫的社区，应对持续升级的犯罪危机。

tmdb-tv-202297.title: 烈焰国度
tmdb-tv-202297.overview: Bode Donovan 是一名年轻罪犯，曾经烧毁了他生命中的一切。为寻求救赎，Bode 加入了北加州一项非常规的监狱释放消防计划，在那里他和其他囚犯以及精英消防员合作扑灭不可预测的大规模火势， 这是项高风险、高回报的任务。当 Bode 被分配到他家乡小镇的项目之后， 五年前留下的秘密也逐渐揭开。

tmdb-tv-256711.title: 造雨人
tmdb-tv-256711.overview: 改编自约翰·格里森姆的同名小说。年轻律师鲁迪·贝勒与布鲁瑟·斯通、迪克·希夫莱特联手，在复杂的法律纠纷中挑战强大势力，揭露案件背后的阴谋，在法庭上为委托人争取正义。

tmdb-tv-284736.title: 警察世家：波士顿
tmdb-tv-284736.overview: 《警察世家：波士顿》是由CBS制作的制作的剧集，讲述前纽约警局探员丹尼·里根在一起涉及其小儿子肖恩的案件后，转而加入波士顿警局。他与莉娜·西尔弗搭档——她出身当地著名警察世家，是家中长女，也是前途无量的“明日之星”。她的祖父彼得斯牧师是波士顿一所历史悠久的浸信会教堂里颇具声望的宗教领袖；他同时是波士顿地区检察官梅·西尔弗的父亲，以及警局总监莎拉·西尔弗（最初称为阿什莉）和新晋巡警乔纳·西尔弗（最初称为艾萨克）的外祖父。

tmdb-tv-387.title: 海绵宝宝
tmdb-tv-387.overview: 海绵宝宝是一块穿着短裤衬衫打领带、暴牙大眼睛的黄色海绵，他生活在太平洋中央一片名为比基尼的海底之下。这里风和日丽，平静祥和，生活无忧无虑。海绵宝宝住在一个菠萝形状的房子里，与之为伴的是他的宠物小蜗（蜗牛）。开朗、纯真的海绵宝宝有许多好朋友，比如乐观单纯的派大星、性格古怪的章鱼哥、自私市侩的蟹老板还有力大无穷的松鼠珊蒂。平时他都在蟹老板的快餐店里打工，闲暇时就和好朋友们四处玩乐。这群性格各异的家伙们凑在一起，可真是闹出不少的笑话……本片为美国最受欢迎的电视系列动画之一，在 2003~2009 年期间，曾经 7 年当选美国儿童选择奖最受欢迎的动画片。

tmdb-tv-253896.title: 幸福之地
tmdb-tv-253896.overview: 鲍比 (丽巴饰) 从她已故的父亲那里继承了一家餐馆，然后她得知自己必须与新发现的同父异母的妹妹共享所有权，两人之间产生了尴尬的紧张关系。

tmdb-tv-322267.title: Newlyweds
tmdb-tv-322267.overview: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.

tmdb-tv-314360.title: 雅嘎疑云
tmdb-tv-314360.overview: 改编自凯特·桑德勒创作的同名舞台剧，并重新演绎巴巴雅嘎的民间传说。私家侦探拉普来到一座海滨小镇，调查大型渔业企业继承人亨利·朴的失踪案。随着调查深入，他与当地警探卡森及迷人的大学教授凯瑟琳发生冲突，并逐渐陷入充满神秘嫌疑人、隐秘生活与古老魔法的迷局。

tmdb-tv-287296.title: Honey
tmdb-tv-287296.overview: Honey goes deep undercover in 1980s East Berlin to explore a shadowy world of counter espionage and risky but irresistible relations. East Berlin, 1982. Martha, 24, is a deep cover agent for MI6. Surrounded by enemies and constantly under threat of her cover being blown, she tries her hardest to avoid detection by Friedrich Bauman, the new Head of Counter Espionage for the Stasi. Finding herself caught between Friedrich and the reckless, arrogant (and incredibly attractive…) CIA operative Aaron Neeland, she is blind-sided by desire in this Cold War menage-a-trois. The risk of being garrotted or incarcerated is nothing compared to the horrifying ordeal of falling in love. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable and bearing your heart and soul? She'd rather have her fingernails ripped off.

imdb-tt32125269.title: Beyond the Gates
imdb-tt32125269.overview: Beyond the Gates is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. Here you'll find a posh gated community with winding tree-lined streets and luxurious mansions to call home. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where our characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life … and some with more grace than others.

tvdb-show-464466.title: I Kill The Bear
tvdb-show-464466.overview: I Kill The Bear is a comedy about a family of bear wranglers for film sets, and why – after 100 years – they've decided to make this film their last.

imdb-tt5622316.title: The Chosen
imdb-tt5622316.overview: The Chosen is the first-ever-multi-season TV show about the life of Jesus. Created outside of the Hollywood system, The Chosen allows us to see Him through the eyes of those who knew him. No matter where you are at in your journey with Jesus Christ, this TV show is for you.

imdb-tt33406999.title: Get Jiro
imdb-tt33406999.overview: In a future Los Angeles controlled by elite chefs, a sushi master named Jiro gets embroiled in a culinary conflict, seeking vengeance through his cooking skills amidst the cutthroat restaurant scene.

imdb-tt12409194.title: Battle Through the Heavens
imdb-tt12409194.overview: In a land where no magic is present. A land where the strong make the rules and weak have to obey. A land filled with alluring treasures and beauty, yet also filled with unforeseen danger. Three years ago, Xiao Yan, who had shown talents none had seen in decades, suddenly lost everything. His powers, his reputation, and his promise to his mother. What sorcery has caused him to lose all of his powers? And why has his fiancee suddenly shown up?

imdb-tt27535062.title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
imdb-tt27535062.original_title: City of God: The Fight Rages On
imdb-tt27535062.overview: City of God: The Fight Rages On takes place two decades after the events of the highly acclaimed film "City of God." City of God: The Fight Rages On is an adapted continuation of the literary work by Paulo Lins, and will follow the story of its characters, starting with the work of the photographer Buscapé. Set in the early 2000s, the series includes excerpts from the film as flashbacks to reconstruct the protagonists' memories.

tvdb-show-478752.title: Overgeared
tvdb-show-478752.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

imdb-tt31131310.title: Mission: Yozakura Family
imdb-tt31131310.overview: High school student Taiyou Asano has been socially inept ever since his family died in a car crash. The only person he can properly interact with is his childhood friend, Mutsumi Yozakura—the head of the world's strongest family of spies. Mutsumi's eldest brother, Kyouichirou Yozakura, has been overprotective of her ever since he once rendered her severely injured. His love for Mutsumi is lethal, and Taiyou is his next target. To survive, Taiyou must marry Mutsumi and become a member of the Yozakura family. Thrown headfirst into chaos, Taiyou begins his journey to become a powerful spy in order to protect his wife and uncover the dark secrets of his past and the Yozakura family.

tvdb-show-320423.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
tvdb-show-320423.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

tvdb-show-459942.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.original_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
tvdb-show-459942.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

imdb-tt4031218.title: Death Battle!
imdb-tt4031218.overview: Death Battle! places two or more characters from pop culture in an all out, no-holds barred slugfest to the death. Who will survive? What weapons will be used? How much blood will be spilled? Death Battle! has the answers.

imdb-tt32062031.title: Sram
imdb-tt32062031.overview: Following the lives of teenagers that attend high school, everyday issues of teenage life, such as friendships, romantic relationships and mental health.Croatian remake of the Norwegian series Skam

tvmaze-episode-3772775.title: Fool in Love
tvmaze-episode-3772775.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

imdb-tt36849871.title: Marshals

tmdb-tv-456.title: The Simpsons
tmdb-tv-456.overview: The Simpsons is the longest running scripted show in US television history. It captures the adventures of Homer, Marge, Maggie, Bart and Lisa who are living in a fictional town called Springfield.

imdb-tt13875494.title: Tracker
imdb-tt13875494.overview: Tracker features lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw, who roams the country as a "reward seeker," using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement to solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

imdb-tt10946316.title: The Institute
imdb-tt10946316.overview: When 12-year-old genius Luke Ellis is kidnapped, he awakens at The Institute, a facility full of children who all got there the same way he did, and who are all possessed of unusual abilities. In a nearby town, haunted former police officer Tim Jamieson has come looking to start a new life, but the peace and quiet won't last, as his story and Luke's are destined to collide.

imdb-tt4406178.title: The Gilded Age
imdb-tt4406178.overview: The American Gilded Age was a period of immense economic change, of huge fortunes made and lost, and the rise of disparity between old money and new.Against this backdrop of change, the story begins in 1882 — introducing young Marian Brook, the orphaned daughter of a Union general, who moves into the New York City home of her thoroughly old money aunts Agnes van Rhijn and Ada Brook. Accompanied by Peggy Scott, an accomplished African-American woman, Marian inadvertently becomes enmeshed in a social war between one of her aunts, a scion of the old money set, and her stupendously rich neighbors, a ruthless railroad tycoon and his ambitious wife, George and Bertha Russell.In this exciting new world that is on the brink of the modern age, will Marian follow the established rules of society, or forge her own path?

imdb-tt21376524.title: Animal Control
imdb-tt21376524.overview: Animal Control is a workplace comedy following a group of Animal Control workers whose lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not.

imdb-tt33359676.title: Maigret
imdb-tt33359676.overview: In Maigret, Chief Inspector Maigret and his team of maverick but loyal detectives, Les Maigrets, solve a series of complex crimes in Paris. Maigret's unconventional methods and unique sense of justice put him at odds with his superiors and the judicial system he is supposed to represent. Maigret must outwit some of Paris's most cunning and violent criminals, while dealing with his own troubled past.

imdb-tt40385667.title: Treasure Island
imdb-tt40385667.overview: Treasure Island charts the transformation of teenager Jim Hawkins from sheltered boy to emboldened young pirate. When Jim gets his hands on a legendary treasure map, his mother Bess' clever and decisive actions leave him holding valuable knowledge that puts both of their lives in danger.

imdb-tt1094229.title: Heartland
imdb-tt1094229.overview: Life is hard on the Flemings' ranch in the Alberta foothills where abused or neglected horses find refuge with a kind, hard-working family. Debts abound and the bank is about to foreclose. Can they keep the ranch running?

imdb-tt15791752.title: Grimsburg
imdb-tt15791752.overview: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack - his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute will follow every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know.

imdb-tt23469464.title: Universal Basic Guys
imdb-tt23469464.overview: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

imdb-tt37960071.title: Crossroad Springs
imdb-tt37960071.overview: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.

imdb-tt38652227.title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza
imdb-tt38652227.overview: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza follows a very scared man as he navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes.

imdb-tt15816496.title: Against the Sky Supreme
imdb-tt15816496.overview: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

tvdb-show-470140.title: One of a Kind Romance
tvdb-show-470140.overview: One of a Kind Romance follows the story of an ordinary job-seeker whose everyday life is suddenly disrupted by a celebrated actor and a rising idol, leading to a romance brimming with personal desires.

tmdb-tv-80748.title: FBI
tmdb-tv-80748.overview: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. These first-class agents, including Special Agent Maggie Bell and her partner, Special Agent Omar Adom 'OA' Zidan, bring all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe.

tmdb-tv-289560.title: CIA
tmdb-tv-289560.overview: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.

imdb-tt1091909.title: Murdoch Mysteries
imdb-tt1091909.overview: Set in Toronto at the dawn of the 20th century, Murdoch Mysteries is a one-hour drama series that explores the intriguing world of William Murdoch, a methodical and dashing detective who pioneers innovative forensic techniques to solve some of the city's most gruesome murders. Murdoch's colleagues include the love of his life, coroner and psychiatrist Dr. Julia Ogden, a staunch ally who shares the detective's fascination for science; Constable George Crabtree, Murdoch's eager but sometimes naïve right-hand man; Inspector Brackenreid, Murdoch's skeptical yet reluctantly supportive boss; and coroner Dr. Emily Grace, Dr. Ogden's protégé.

imdb-tt21433690.title: St. Denis Medical
imdb-tt21433690.overview: St. Denis Medical is a mockumentary about an underfunded, understaffed Oregon hospital where the dedicated doctors and nurses try their best to treat patients while maintaining their own sanity.

imdb-tt42496001.title: Line of Fire
imdb-tt42496001.overview: When a U.S. Marshal falls in the line of duty, a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy as a family of law enforcement agents become the target of a mysterious assassin. Bridging personal differences and crossing professional boundaries, the Hollingsworth family must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice... even if it means betraying their sworn code.

The suffering that mankind has experienced during this period of time is known as the "Great Nirvana Period." Not only that, Luo Feng not only carried the burden of supporting the family but also to protect the human homeland, for the better survival and development of mankind, together with other justice warriors, to join hands against the fierce monsters. tmdb-tv-4614.title: NCIS
tmdb-tv-4614.overview: NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) is more than just an action drama. With liberal doses of humor, it's a show that focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. Leroy Jethro Gibbs, a former Marine gunnery sergeant, whose skills as an investigator are unmatched, leads this troupe of colorful personalities. Rounding out the team are Anthony DiNozzo, an ex-homicide detective whose instincts in the field are unparalleled and whose quick wit and humorous take on life make him a team favorite; the youthful and energetic forensic specialist Abby Sciuto, a talented scientist whose sharp mind matches her Goth style and eclectic tastes; Caitlin Todd, an ex-Secret Service Agent; and Timothy McGee, an MIT graduate whose brilliance with computers far overshadows his insecurities in the field; Assisting the team is medical examiner Dr. Donald "Ducky" Mallard, who knows it all because he's seen it all, and he's not afraid to let you know. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents travel the globe to investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.

imdb-tt30796986.title: NCIS: Origins
imdb-tt30796986.overview: In NCIS: Origins, young Leroy Jethro Gibbs starts his career as a newly minted special agent at the fledgling NCIS Camp Pendleton office where he forges his place on a gritty, ragtag team led by NCIS legend Mike Franks.

imdb-tt36885662.title: Best Medicine
imdb-tt36885662.overview: In Best Medicine a brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a small-town doctor where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connections.

imdb-tt41814911.title: NCIS: New York
imdb-tt41814911.overview: Legendary NCIS Agent Sam Hanna returns to his hometown of New York City to their field office, partnering with a roguish agent and helping lead a new team as they are tasked with high-stakes missions to defend one of the most vital cities and ports in the world.

imdb-tt26748321.title: Doc
imdb-tt26748321.overview: Doc centers on the hard-charging, brilliant Dr. Amy Larsen, Chief of Internal and Family Medicine at Westside Hospital in Minneapolis. After a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life, Amy must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves and the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

imdb-tt11231226.title: Reasonable Doubt
imdb-tt11231226.overview: In Reasonable Doubt, you'll judge Jax Stewart for her questionable ethics and wild interpretations of the law... until you're the one in trouble. Then you'll see her for what she is: the most brilliant and fearless defense attorney in Los Angeles who bucks the justice system at every chance she gets.

imdb-tt21952924.title: Phony
imdb-tt21952924.overview: Phony is a coming-of-age mystery about a teenager who wakes up in the hospital after a car accident to discover his mom - his only parent and his best friend - appears to have been replaced by an impostor.

imdb-tt21906238.title: Rivals
imdb-tt21906238.overview: Rivals dives headfirst into the cut-throat world of independent television in 1986, where the shoulder pads are big and ambitions even bigger. In the fictional upper-class county of Rutshire, a long-standing rivalry between two powerful men is about to boil over: ex-Olympian, Member of Parliament, and notorious womaniser Rupert Campbell-Black, and his Rutshire neighbour Tony Baddingham, controller of the independent TV franchise Corinium Television. As tensions rise and rivalries deepen, there are spilled secrets, forged alliances, and snatched liaisons that draw wives, lovers, colleagues, friends, and families into their battle.

tmdb-tv-248830.title: Stick
tmdb-tv-248830.overview: Pryce Cahill is an over-the-hill, ex-pro golfer whose career was derailed prematurely 20 years ago. After the collapse of his marriage and getting fired from his job at an Indiana sporting goods store, Pryce hedges his bets, and future, entirely on a troubled 17-year-old golf phenom named Santi. Stick is a heartfelt, feel-good comedy about a found family and their relationships set within the world of golf as it's never been shown before.

imdb-tt29011445.title: Where's Wanda?
imdb-tt29011445.overview: Where's Wanda? tells the story of Dedo and Carlotta Klatt, who are desperate to locate their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda, who disappeared months ago without a trace. When the police fail to find her, the family takes matters into their own hands, obtaining surveillance devices with the help of their tech-savvy son Ole. Disguising themselves as employees of an electrical company, they bug first their neighborhood and then half their suburb, finding out that behind closed doors none of their neighbors are who they pretend to be.

mal-57612.overview:
In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-64084.title: 世界最强的魔女，就此开始
mal-64084.overview:
After using her SSS-Rank skill, Internet, to crush her former family’s ambitions, Lorna is free to travel the world. Her next stop is the port town of Aquas, where she hopes to see the sights and chow down on some fresh seafood. But when she arrives, the place is on the brink of destruction thanks to a certain Weekly Quest… Good thing Lorna has the gods on her side!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-63431.title: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。　～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～

mal-63431.english_title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
mal-63431.overview:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.
Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.
The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.
Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.
This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!
(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

mal-64340.title: 装备我最强
mal-64340.overview:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

mal-61967.title: ブラッククローバー 第2期
mal-61967.overview:
As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-61987.title: 药屋少女的呢喃 第三季
mal-61987.overview:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."

To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.

From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-61990.title: サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ2
mal-61990.overview:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 pulls you back into Night City, where lives become entangled to the extreme. Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found. Across this ten-episode standalone series, uncover a story of family, obsession, legacy — and how your lens reflects the stories of the people around you..

When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?
(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site, Official Twitter)

mal-61578.title: 学生会也有洞！
mal-61578.original_title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
mal-61578.english_title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
mal-61578.overview:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards.
However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

(Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

mal-59204.title: 魔法騎士レイアース (2026)
mal-59204.overview:
Hikaru Shidou, Umi Ryuuzaki, and Fuu Hououji aren't from Cephiro. While on a school field trip to the Tokyo Tower, the three girls' minds are on anything but different worlds filled with magic and wonder. That is, until Princess Emeraude, the Pillar of Cephiro, cries out for the Magic Knights to save her world--and that just happens to be those three!


(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-63382.title: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン
mal-63382.overview:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

mal-63409.title: 你好，我是受心上人所托来做恋爱药的魔女。
mal-63409.original_title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai Sareta Majo desu.
mal-63409.english_title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
mal-63409.overview:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)

mal-63754.title: 冷淡的佐藤同学只对我撒娇
mal-63754.original_title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
mal-63754.english_title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
mal-63754.overview:
Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer.

Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat!

Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

mal-61469.title: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スティール・ボール・ラン 2nd＆3rd STAGE
mal-61469.original_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run - 2nd & 3rd STAGE
mal-61469.english_title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd STAGE
mal-61469.overview:
In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide..

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)

mal-63367.title: 龙珠超 比鲁斯
mal-63367.overview:
Several years have passed since the fierce battle against Majin Buu, and Earth has finally regained a brief moment of peace. At the same time, Beerus, the God of Destruction, awakens from his long, deep sleep.
Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

mal-63293.title: 萤火虫的出嫁
mal-63293.overview:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

mal-61603.overview:
Aoi Ashito’s game has now earned him a spot on the A team, but he is quickly overwhelmed by his harsh new reality. Surrounded by elite players like Kuribayashi and Akutsu, practices are just as merciless as the matches. In this U-18 Premier League of powerhouse talent, Ashito must evolve or be crushed, if he’s ever to be acknowledged.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

mal-56733.title: マジカル★エクスプローラー　エロゲの友人キャラに転生したけど、ゲーム知識使って自由に生きる
mal-56733.original_title: Magical★Explorer: Eroge no Yuujin Chara ni Tensei Shitakedo, Game Chishiki Tsukatte Jiyuu ni Ikiru
mal-56733.overview:
Few titles are more revered among horndogs-(ahem) connoisseurs of Japanese erotic video games-than Magical Explorer. One day, our smut-loving hero wakes up to find he has been reincarnated into the body of the game’s dreamboat protagonist! Or rather, his hapless comic-relief best friend, Kousuke Takioto. But with his unparalleled knowledge of Magical Explorer and Kousuke’s unorthodox abilities (a scarf that doubles as a fist?), our hero vows to turn the game’s unluckiest loser into its mightiest heartthrob. In this world, nothing is out of reach when you’ve got the know-how!

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Each episode streamed 1 week early on ABEMA and d anime store. The original TV broadcast started on October 4th, 2026.

mal-64534.title: 冰之城墙 第二季
mal-64534.overview:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by… 

(Source: Netflix)

mal-63098.title: PSYREN -决战游戏-
mal-63098.overview:
One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth.
A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.”
When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

(Source: PSYЯEN Official Site)

mal-63509.title: 黑暗召唤师在地下恋爱中
mal-63509.overview:
Amona’s a dark summoner with demonic powers. Roni’s a devout priest who’s way too uptight. By all rights, they should hate each other. Instead, they end up fast-tracking their enemies-to-lovers arc with a one-night stand that somehow insists on becoming a recurring event. Now they must hide their situationship from the rest of the party while denying their growing attraction to one another, all while dealing with an imp who’s far too invested in their love life.

(Source: HIDIVE)

mal-62922.title: 用【循环利息】强制收回借出的魔力
mal-62922.original_title: Kashita Maryoku wa [Revo Barai] de Kyousei Choushuu
mal-62922.english_title: Magic Repo Man: Dumped by My Party, I’ll Cash In With a Cute Support Fairy to Become the Strongest!
mal-62922.overview:
If there's one thing you can never have enough of in a world of RPG-style swords and sorcery, it's magic points! Whether you're fueling spells, techniques, or showing off an incredible ability, you've gotta spend those points to do real damage. But what if you run out?

Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the “Skypiercers,” and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious…until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!
(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

tmdb-tv-321958.title: 火线家族
tmdb-tv-321958.overview:
这是一个由执法人员组成的家族——成员分别供职于 FBI、美国法警署（US Marshals）、特勤局（Secret Service）及司法部（DOJ）。他们既要弥合彼此间的家庭裂痕，又时常在工作中跨越职权边界，联手处理各类重大案件。

　　然而，一宗本以为简单明了的案件，竟演变为致命阴谋。此刻，他们必须动用一生累积的、用来保护平民与政要的办案专长——转而来保护彼此，将真凶绳之以法……
